result.topic_en: A printed Latin doctoral diploma of the Göttingen law faculty, issued under King George V of Hanover with Hermann Sauppe as prorector and Wilhelm Francke as dean, conferring the doctorate in both laws on Hermann Stockfleth of Hamburg on 29 July 1861.
